card.name: Priming spray pumps by actuating
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "by", "and" or "between" in priming instructions for nasal sprays, pumps and inhalers, right before a word like actuating, pressing or releasing.

modes.label: Priming by releasing sprays
modes.description: The word "by" after a priming instruction, ahead of releasing or actuating sprays.

modes.description: Linking or nearby words in inhaler or pump instructions where actuating the device comes next.

card.writes: It promotes forms of "act" (as in actuate or actuator) and suppresses "click".
card.plain: It marks the spot in spray or pump priming directions where the next word is likely to be "actuating".
